title: Account health review
description: For a change that affects existing customers: a written health score, a monthly review of upcoming renewals and an action plan for each account at risk.

sources.title: Bain & Company, Measuring your Net Promoter Score
Stripe, Billing analytics (MRR, churn and subscriber reports)

rules.instruction: Write the inputs, weights and data sources of the account health score and the thresholds for each status.
rules.verification: Open the health score definition and check each input, weight, source and threshold.

rules.instruction: Each month, review the renewals of the next 90 days with their health status, value and owner.
rules.verification: Check that the last renewal review is less than 31 days old and that every renewal listed has an owner.

rules.instruction: Give every account at risk an action plan with an action, an owner and a due date.
rules.verification: Export the accounts at risk from the CRM and check that none lacks a plan, owner or due date.

rules.instruction: Compute churn and net revenue retention with the formula written in the metrics glossary, the same way each period.
rules.verification: Compare the dashboard formula with the glossary definition.
